quests.title: Remnants of the Shadow Realm

dialogue.t: Interesting. So there's a hidden room inside these ruins.
Based on my recent observations, all the artifacts here date back to the Belyi Tsar's era.
Rumor has it that during his reign, he tasked a mysterious organization with excavating technological artifacts from the Shadow Realm and putting them to use.
I didn't think we'd find so many here... These ruins must have been connected to the excavation work.
See? I told you bringing him here would be a huge help. He's a real expert in this field.
I don't know about "expert"... but I've always been fascinated by this kind of stuff...
Anyway, {NICKNAME} — as long as you keep unlocking permissions, we should be able to get our hands on all the tech here.
Cool, that's a lot of stuff... Nothing compatible with my rifle, though, by the looks of it. Shame.

quests.description: As you continue upgrading your access card, you activate a hidden space…
